---
title: "worked_example"
---
part one of just loading and viewing the data before any formating
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_site_locations <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
migratory_connectivity_dataset <- read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

gt(breeding_site_locations)
colnames(breeding_site_locations)
glimpse(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
gt(head(migratory_connectivity_dataset))
dim(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
```

now creating smaller databases without the junk
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
# gt(bird_breeding_selected)

bird_migration_sites <- migratory_connectivity_dataset |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename( Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, 
          Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, 
          Stopover_Longitude = pslon, 
          Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
          Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
          Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
          Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
          Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

# gt(bird_migration_sites)
```
 removing spain
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_sites |> filter(Site != "Spain")
```
